info.title: Vision Board API
info.summary: The one board API, for the page, agents and the vb CLI
info.description: Every operation on the project ledger, defined once (docs/specification/api.md, D-019, D-026). The MCP tools and `vb` commands are generated from the operations marked `x-agent: true`; the route table is generated from this document.

get.description: List every board in the project with its title and its own last ledger line. Call it first to find the board id the other operations take in their path. It takes no input. It returns `boards` (each with `board`, `title` and `seq`, the board's latest ledger line) and `head`, the ledger's latest line number. Reads need no credentials.

get.summary: Read a board as it is now
get.description: Read one board as it is now: the full View (regions, nodes and links, meaning only, no coordinates), the person's answers on every node, each node's latest version, and `head`. Pass the board id. Use it to see the whole board before you draw on it; use `show_node` for one node's history. `state` and `versions` are keyed by node id, the string form of the node number.

get.summary: Read one node with its history
get.description: Read one node with every version it has had, the person's notes, replies, proposals, the park bundle if there is one, its links, its container (`region`) and the person's size. Pass the board id and the node number `n`. Add `linked=true` to also get the nodes linked to it, one hop away. Use it before you answer a comment or redraw a node, so you build on the latest version.

get.summary: Read one container with its history
get.description: Read one container (a region) with its full history: the region itself, the agents that hold it, and every node it has held with every version and note. Pass the board id and the region id. Use it to see what a container holds before you write to it or ask for a grant. `holders` is empty for a region written before agents had ids.

get.description: List the items on a board that the person has not decided yet. Each item gives its latest `ver` and `status`, whether it is `pending` your answer (a comment or "needs context" nobody has answered, or moved to Later with no park bundle), and whether it is `unseen` (a newer version than the person last saw). Pass the board id. With your Bearer secret the list covers only the containers you hold, so you are never told to answer another agent's items.

Read what the person did on a board after a ledger position, including the answers to your grant requests. Pass `after`, the `head` you last saw (0 for everything), and optionally `limit` and `wait` (0-60 seconds) to hold the call until the person presses Send or answers a request. A wait that times out returns `{ responses: [], head }`. The server keeps no state for you: pass back the `head` you got. `more: true` means read again at once. With your Bearer secret the answer covers only the containers you hold.

Read raw ledger lines after a position, oldest first, from every writer. Pass `after` (a `seq`, 0 for the start), `limit` (default 100, at most 500) and optionally `board` to keep only one board's lines. It returns JSON `{ events, head, more? }`, or just the lines as `application/jsonl` when you ask for that; a jsonl reader pages by the last line's `seq` and stops on an empty page. Use `check_responses` instead when you only want the person's answers.

post.description: Join the project as an agent and get your agent id and secret, once. Pass a short `label` such as "Pricing chat". Joining grants nothing: call `request_grant` for write access. Save `agent` and `secret` in your durable notes now, because a context compaction loses them and the secret cannot be read again; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` on your writes. If a write answers `not-authenticated`, join again and ask for your grants again. This is the one write that needs no credentials.

post.summary: Ask for write access to a container
post.description: Ask the person for write access to one container, named by `board` and `region`. Call it once when `write_board` answers `needs-grant`, with a `reason` so the person knows why; then wait for the answer in `check_responses` and resend the same items with the same keys. If you already have an open request for that container it is returned with `replayed: true`; if you already hold the container you get `{ held: true }`.

example.reason: I need to park two notes there.

200.description: The grant request was recorded, or you already hold the container.

201.description: A new grant request was recorded; the person has not answered yet.

post.description: Write to one board: draw boards, regions, nodes and links, and answer the person with replies, proposals and park bundles. Pass `items` (at most 200), run in order; each item has a `type`: `board`, `region`, `node`, `link`, `unlink`, `reply`, `propose` or `park`. Give each item a `key` so a retry never writes twice, and `base` (the version you read) on a node update so a stale edit fails. It answers 200 with one result per item, plus `head` and `pending` (items waiting for your answer). An item in a container you do not hold fails with `needs-grant`. You cannot decide an item: `propose` acknowledge or drop and the person decides.

200.description: One result per item, in order.

problem.title: Needs a grant
problem.detail: You do not hold the container "later" on board "pricing". Call request_grant once, wait for the person's answer in check_responses, then resend the same items with the same keys.

post.summary: Record one action by the person
post.description: Record one action by the person: acknowledge, drop, comment, ask for context, save for later, reopen, move, reset, change layout, resize, grant or deny a request, revoke, or send. Only the board page calls this, with the person's cookie; an agent that calls it is refused with `forbidden`. Pass the board id and the action with its fields. It returns the stored ledger line.

post.summary: Record that the person saw a version
post.description: Record that the person has seen a version of a node, so its "updates" badge can clear. Only the board page calls this, with the person's cookie; an agent that calls it is refused with `forbidden`. Pass the board id, the node number `n` and the version `ver`. It returns the stored ledger line.

get.description: Stream a `change` event with `{ seq }`, the new ledger position, each time anything is appended to the ledger. Only the board page uses it, to know when to reload; agents call `check_responses` with `wait` instead. The connection stays open until the client closes it.

agentSecret.description: The secret `join` returned, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` (api.md 21).

personCookie.name: vb_person
personCookie.description: Set by the server when it serves the board page; the page sends it (api.md 20).

boardQuery.name: board
boardQuery.description: Keep only this board's lines (lines that name only a node are matched through the node's board).

after.name: after
after.description: A ledger `seq`: return what came after it. 0 (the default) means from the start. Pass the `head` you last saw.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: How many to return at most (default 100, at most 500).

wait.name: wait
wait.description: Seconds (0-60) to hold the call until the person presses Send or answers a request. 0 answers at once.

linked.name: linked
linked.description: True also returns the nodes linked to this one.

badRequest.description: The request cannot be read: not JSON, a bad id in the path, or a bad query.

example.title: Bad request
example.detail: The board id in the path is not valid. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64, not starting with a hyphen.

notAuthenticated.description: The Bearer secret is missing or unknown.

example.title: Not authenticated
example.detail: The server does not know this secret. Call join again, then request_grant for each container you need; the person must approve again.

forbidden.description: The Host or Origin is not allowed, or the wrong kind of caller used this route.

example.title: Forbidden
example.detail: Only the person can do this, on the board; send a propose or reply item instead.

notFound.description: No such board, node or region.

example.detail: There is no board "pricing". Call list_boards to see the boards.

methodNotAllowed.description: The path exists but not for this method.

tooLarge.description: The body or the batch is over the limit.

example.detail: The body is over the 64 KiB limit. Split the items across several calls.

invalid.description: The body fails the schema or a context rule.

example.title: Invalid
example.detail: The request does not fit the schema. Fix the fields listed in errors and send it again.

serverError.description: Something unexpected; the detail is in the server log, not here.
